title: Frontier ranking
description: A DERIVED, ephemeral artifact (NOT a canonical store object): the ranked frontier the `/strategize` skill emits for the dashboard (PLAN Q9, req #9). It lives at research_os/render/frontier_ranking.json alongside the other derived render artifacts (the live-head, the plot-stream manifest) and is gitignored. The web backend only ever READS it — the boundary (Q1/Q11) is intact. A new ranking overwrites the old one; the artifact carries the store revision it ranked (`generated_for_rev`) so the dashboard can flag it stale once the store moves. Because it is lens-dependent and re-derivable, it is never referentially-closed by loop/validate.py.

lens.description: The ranking lens this pass used (the human's call per phase).

generated_at.description: ISO timestamp the ranking was produced.

generated_for_rev.description: The store revision (indexer.store_revision()) this ranking was computed against; the dashboard marks the ranking stale when the live store rev differs.

items.description: Frontier goal nodes in priority order (rank 1 = highest).

goal_id.description: The ranked goal node id (must resolve in goals/).

rationale.description: One line under the chosen lens, store-cited.

action.description: The concrete next action — what one run would move it.

cost.description: Rough cost, e.g. '~30 min' (from the node budget or nearest-analog run).

crux.description: The one uncertain thing whose outcome can't be predicted.
